name: kb_restoration_druid
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's restoration druid casts, added after role_healer: the max-rank Healing Touch emergency, Rejuvenation kept on the hurt, Regrowth on the tank, the rank-3 Rejuvenation blanket and Tranquility at ten hurt, and Innervate itself when the mana runs low. Entries run in band high, so they pre-empt the generic heal; the narrower conditions come first, which is the one departure from the KB's numeric order.

rows.text: Pre-pull: Rejuvenation then Regrowth on the tank |
Nature's Swiftness -> max-rank Healing Touch (two presses) or Swiftmend | tank below ~30%

entries.note: Moved ahead of the KB's order and in band emergency (not high): the KB puts it above the routine heals, and role_healer's own emergency rule would otherwise take the tick.

rows.unexpressed: a self-cast cooldown cannot read the heal target (the heal conditions need target heal)

rows.text: Swiftmend | target HoT about to expire
rows.unexpressed: time left on an aura is not in the conditions

rows.text: Rejuvenation (R11; R5 on rogues/ferals for T3 2-piece) | damaged target without it; before Regrowth (Preservation)

entries.note: The KB's rank 11 (highest) is the default; the rank-5-for-rogues concession is gear, not a condition.

rows.text: Regrowth (R9 tanks/melee, R4 casters) | tank and spiky damage (~60-70% of casts)

entries.note: The KB's ranks by target armor class (R9 melee, R4 casters) are not conditions; the highest known rank goes.

rows.text: Rejuvenation R1 on self | mana needed and wearing T3 2-piece (~180 mana/12 s)

entries.note: The KB's T3 2-piece trick: rank 1 on itself, mana back through the set bonus.

rows.text: no HoT on full-health targets | always
rows.unexpressed: a "never" rule the healer triage keeps (it heals nobody above its threshold)

entries.note: Tree Form is the preset's druid_caster strategy's business: it cancels the form above a heal.

rows.text: Rejuvenation blanket (rank 3 at low healing power)

entries.note: Moved ahead of the single-target Rejuvenation: at three hurt the KB's blanket is the cast, and the conditions are all-must-hold. The rank is the KB's low-healing-power one.

rows.text: Tranquility | 1-2 casts per raid; interrupted by Sapphiron's aura [[d:druid#1476245899612131513]] [[d:druid#1302718473369030768]]
rows.unexpressed: nothing to add: the row names no cast the list does not already have

rows.text: Swiftmend | consumes the HoT with the fewest ticks left [[d:druid#1476571037243019437]]
rows.unexpressed: time left on an aura is not in the conditions

rows.text: Nature's Swiftness | instant max-rank Healing Touch emergency
rows.unexpressed: a self-cast cooldown cannot read the heal target (the heal conditions need target heal)

rows.text: Innervate | self at ~600 Spirit = 100% regen 15 s; swap to a Spirit staff first [[d:druid#1465410896120643595]] [[d:druid#1464971421745807653]]

entries.note: The Spirit-staff swap the KB asks for first is gear; 40% for 'about 600 Spirit' is the healer engine's mana-save threshold. The preset's druid_innervate keeps its own rule.
